# [CS068] High Cyclomatic Complexity (high-complexity)

A function's cyclomatic complexity exceeds metrics.max_cyclomatic.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | MEDIUM |
| **Category** | Code Metrics |
| **CWE** | - |
| **OWASP** | - |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Each branch doubles the paths to test and review. Functions above the threshold (default 15) are where bugs and missed security checks concentrate. Split the function or replace branches with lookups.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
func price(o Order) int { /* 20 nested if and switch branches */ }
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
func price(o Order) int {
	return base(o) + shipping(o) - discount(o)
}
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [high-complexity]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    high-complexity: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore high-complexity -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** high-complexity
```
